next.reason: 1985 GR5: USE procedures run 'after completion of the standard input-output exception routine upon the unsuccessful execution of an input-output operation unless an AT END or INVALID KEY phrase takes precedence', with cases a-e for file-name-1, INPUT, OUTPUT, I-O and EXTEND. §2023:14.9.49.4 GR6 restates the sentence and a-e word for word; its exception-checking PERFORM precondition always holds for a 1985 program, which has no such PERFORM. The file-name-1 precedence is also §2023:14.9.49.4 GR5, and the AT END / INVALID KEY precedence is stated as 'any applicable exception processing statements are not executed' (§2023:9.1.14 GR2) and 'Any other applicable exception processing statements are not executed' (§2023:14.9.30.4 GR24). Same (as the indexed sibling 1985-GR-IX.4.8.4-5).
